name: caterhub
description: CaterHub — frontend Next.js + REST API Express (npm workspaces).

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w backend run typecheck && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w frontend run typecheck && npm -w backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w frontend run test && npm -w backend run test
